lines.text: Many learners say: He said me the truth.
Better: He told me the truth.
Say does not take a person. Use tell.
Told! She told me a story.

data.why: Say does not take a person. Use tell.

native.tip: Avec une personne, on dit “told me”. “Said me” n'existe pas.
